catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class carries a multi-source waveform trace from an oscilloscope: cap.measure.voltage.v1 is one scalar voltage bound to instrument.dmm, instrument.smu or sensor, cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, and no class binds the instrument kind for a trace plus its per-source time base and vertical window. The action returns the WaveformCollection the upstream curve feature builds.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; nothing ran on hardware and no hardware run is claimed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver over curvequery._tek_series_mso_curve_feat:TekSeriesCurveFeat with native.py, not the card's ScpiDriver; the upstream is a Visadore feature object that assembles per-source commands from the source name and reads the curve as an IEEE binary block, so a command table cannot express it. The driver serves the curve feature only: TekSeriesCurveFeat has one public method, feature(), and the setup, default-setup and acquire features are different upstream classes (TekSeriesSetupFeat, TekSeriesDefaultFeat, TekSeriesAcquireFeat), which one native symbol cannot reach. NOT COVERED: the setup/default-setup/acquire features and any scalar identity, channel or acquisition settings; the clone's curve feature exposes none of them. The fake returns six samples per trace (test data, all # placeholder); the real record length is the instrument's horizontal:recordlength? reply, which the clone reads but does not bound, and the upstream downloads the whole record. The input is one boolean, so the driver declares no Limit and there is no site-limits.example.json; the action is R0 observation and controls no physical output. The G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE warning is expected for this package: an R0 observational action with no numeric input has no limit for SAFE-014 to probe, so the suite awards CL2 although every other CL3 test passes; adding a numeric input only to satisfy the probe would invent an interface the upstream does not have. native.py imports pyvisa and the clone only on the hardware path and builds the upstream feature with the resource_manager and resource_name attributes its feature() uses; that path was not run. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
